name: webhooks
title: Webhooks
description: Outgoing webhooks for resource events: Standard Webhooks signatures, a MongoDB delivery queue with retries and a delivery log, per-user visibility, SSRF protection and secret rotation. Zero dependencies.
docs:
1. POST /api/webhooks { url, events: ['post.created', 'post.*'] } -> { data: { id, secret, ... } }   (the secret is shown once)
2. Each matching change is POSTed as { type, timestamp, data }, with webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature headers (Standard Webhooks).
3. Receivers check them: verifyWebhook(secret, req.headers, rawBody) from app/blocks/webhooks/signing.js (copy the file) or any Standard Webhooks library.
Users only receive records they may read, serialized like the API returns them. Admins can pass scope: 'global'.
Also: POST /api/webhooks/:id/test, /rotate-secret, GET /api/webhooks/:id/deliveries, POST /api/webhooks/:id/deliveries/:deliveryId/retry.
Set CALM_ENCRYPTION_KEYS (npx calm keygen --write) so signing secrets are encrypted at rest. Set WEBHOOKS_WORKER=off on instances that should not send.
